posts.text:
All my feature dreams for Interior AI are coming true now :D

One idea I had was to let you upload your own wallpaper and set it, it was a pain to even get an image model to put that properly

With a 3d model it's much easier, so now you can walk around you room, upload a wallpaper texture and add it to any wall or object

And you can set the material of any object too

When you're done press [ ✨ Render ] and it becomes a photo!
posts.text_zh:
我为 Interior AI 设想的那些功能，现在都在实现了 :D

我曾有一个想法，是让你上传自己的壁纸并贴上去，但以前哪怕让图像模型把壁纸正确地贴上去都很痛苦

有了 3D 模型就容易多了，现在你可以在房间里走动，上传一张壁纸纹理，把它贴到任意墙面或物体上

你还可以设置任意物体的材质

弄完之后按 [ ✨ Render ]，它就会变成一张照片！

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早的帖子，介绍 Interior AI 新增的悬停 [ 🎨 Style ] 菜单，可在 3D 里快速预览风格，看中后按 [ Render ] 就能得到照片级效果；他还想把 3D 走查送进 Seedance 一类视频模型，做成完整的照片级室内改造走查视频。

posts.text:
Status symbols today:

- Taking private lessons in chess, jazz piano, or French in your late 30s
- Knowing your VO2 max, DEXA stats, and ApoB
- Having zero clue what the internet is mad about today
- Wired Apple earbuds on video calls
- More than 2 kids 
- 100% natural fiber clothing (linen, merino, cashmere, zero polyester)
- Empty calendars
- Caring about microplastics
- No TV in the main living room
- Having lots of followers or being off social completely
- Being sober
- Eating "clean"
- Type of water you drink
- Private school for kids
- Traveling to Japan
- Premium skincare
- 2nd house
- Backyard pizza oven
- 2+ fridges
- Ordering off menu because you've gone to the same spot since 2014
- Charcuterie boards
- Single estate olive oil and tinned fish
- Hosting Sunday dinners where phones go in a wooden bowl by the front door
- Private chef
- 2000s manual Porsche 911 over any brand new supercar
- 90s Toyota Land Cruiser or old Volvo wagon as the daily driver
- Talking about seed oils a lot
- Dyson vacuums
- Limewash walls and unlacquered brass hardware that patinas over time
- $95 heavyweight blank white tees (Lady White Co., Merz b. Schwanen, Buck Mason etc)
- Beautiful workstation
- Raw A2 milk from a local farm drop
- Le Labo products
- Talking about cold plunges 
- Custom cedar sauna + outdoor shower in the backyard
- Secondhand goods with stories
- Cast iron and stainless steel pans only
- Eating organic
- Buying half a cow from a regenerative ranch (and owning a garage chest freezer just for it)
- Japanese selvedge denim and unbranded cashmere
- Taking afternoon calls on a walk (refusing to turn on Zoom camera)
- Hi-Fi audio
- Framed art from artists you met in person
- Mortgage rate below 3%
- La Marzocco coffee maker
- Owning your last name .com (and it's your email too)
- Charizards
- Wearing a faded crewneck from a tiny bakery in Copenhagen or Kyoto
- Reading books
- Phone permanently on Do Not Disturb
- Work/life balance
- Analog hobbies (Leica film cameras, fountain pens, woodworking)
- Kids with zero iPad time (wooden toys + outdoor school)
- Bone broth
- Digital detoxing
- Taking the entire month of August off like an old-world European
- iPhone Air or iPhone Duo

Okay, I'll stop.

So, what did I miss?

posts.text:
"My Grok Bot advisor talked me out of a $1.35M mistake" - @Rasmic 

Here’s how to set up your own advisor Grok Bot:

1. Create a new bot in Grok Bot and name it Advisor
2. Search “finance” in plugins and connect your accounts through Plaid
3. Tell it your goals for the year: what you’re saving for and what you’re building
4. Give it one job: “Stop me from making bad decisions. Be blunt.”
5. Before any big move, send it the details and ask “wdyt of this.” A purchase, an investment, an acquisition, a new business idea.
posts.text_zh:
「我的 Grok Bot 顾问劝住了我，让我避免了一个 $1.35M 的错误」——@Rasmic

下面是如何搭建你自己的顾问 Grok Bot：

1. 在 Grok Bot 里新建一个 bot，命名为 Advisor
2. 在插件里搜索 “finance”，并通过 Plaid 连接你的账户
3. 告诉它你今年的目标：你在为什么存钱，以及你在做什么
4. 只交给它一项任务：“Stop me from making bad decisions. Be blunt.”
5. 在任何大动作之前，把细节发给它，问一句 “wdyt of this.” 一次购买、一笔投资、一次收购，或一个新的商业想法。

posts.text:
Some quick observations on Anthropic's IPO:

1/ The number of customers paying $100K or more grew 12x in a year, to over 11,900. And the existing ones are spending about 9x what they did 1 year ago (wild).

2/ The net loss is $23.3B, but $21.9B of that is a paper loss. They owe early investors shares, and those shares got more valuable, so accounting rules count it as a loss (has to do with convertible notes etc being exchanged)

3/ Revenue per employee is over $6.6M!

4/ They did $17B in revenue last quarter, and that's up more than 12x from a year ago.

5/ The stat they feature most is compute efficiency, where they say they get 4x more revenue per dollar of compute than in early 2025. ( I think this is a metric they defined themselves but not 100% sure)

6/ It's a public benefit corporation, so shareholders are buying into a company that's legally allowed to weigh other goals alongside their returns.

7/ You can request shares at the IPO price through Robinhood, SoFi, Schwab, Fidelity and E*TRADE, which I think is somewhat unusual for an IPO this size, but maybe it's a sign of the times?

8/ The whole roadshow is an 11 chapter video that anyone can watch, and it's cool that they shared it.

9/ The ticker is $ANT. It's expected to price on November 18 and start trading the next day.

10/ One of the case studies is about Sparky, Walmart’s shopping assistant, and they say orders through it are about 35% bigger. What’s interesting to me is that shoppers only ever see Walmart, and Anthropic is the plumbing underneath. Sidenote: I co-founded @MeetLCA an agency that builds experiences like this big companies/big startups so this trend is what I'm seeing too (demand for agent experience products)

11/ The founders' letter tells investors to "never let your company be worth a dollar more than it is actually worth." I haven't seen that in an IPO pitch before.

12/ About 250 customers pay them $10M or more a year, and over 1,900 pay $1M or more.

13/ They spent $9.9B on compute last quarter, which is more than half of revenue. $5B of that was bought on short-term deals that cost a lot more, which tells me demand is running ahead of what they planned for.

14/ All 7 co-founders are still at the company, and they lose about 1% of the people they want to keep each year.

15/ They recorded $1.1B in stock based compensation last quarter.

16/ They have about $96B in cash and have raised about $141B in total.

Note: this is not financial advice. Do your own research. I share things I find interesting about startups and building businesses in real-time.

Whether you're into AI or not, this is a historic moment for tech, AI and the USA.

关于 Anthropic IPO 的一些快速观察：

1/ 每年付费 $100K 或以上的客户数量在一年内增长了 12 倍，超过 11,900 家。而且原有客户的花费大约是一年前的 9 倍（离谱）。

2/ 净亏损是 $23.3B，但其中 $21.9B 是账面亏损。他们欠早期投资者股份，而这些股份变得更值钱了，所以会计规则把它计为亏损（和可转换债券等被兑换有关）

3/ 人均营收超过 $6.6M！

4/ 上一季度营收 $17B，比一年前增长超过 12 倍。

5/ 他们最突出展示的数据是算力效率（compute efficiency），称现在每一美元算力带来的收入是 2025 年初的 4 倍。（我觉得这是他们自己定义的指标，但不是 100% 确定）

6/ 这是一家公共利益公司（public benefit corporation），所以股东买进的是一家法律上被允许在回报之外同时权衡其他目标的公司。

7/ 你可以通过 Robinhood、SoFi、Schwab、Fidelity 和 E*TRADE 按 IPO 价格申购股份。对这种体量的 IPO 来说我觉得这有点少见，但也许这就是这个时代的信号？

8/ 整场路演是一部 11 章的视频，任何人都可以看，他们愿意公开分享这一点很酷。

9/ 股票代码是 $ANT。预计 11 月 18 日定价，次日开始交易。

10/ 其中一个案例是关于 Sparky，也就是 Walmart 的购物助手，他们说通过它产生的订单大约大 35%。让我觉得有意思的是，购物者始终只看到 Walmart，而 Anthropic 是底层的管道。题外话：我联合创办了 @MeetLCA，一家为这样的大公司/大创业公司做体验的机构，所以这个趋势我也正在看到（对 agent experience 产品的需求）

11/ 创始人信里告诉投资者：「never let your company be worth a dollar more than it is actually worth.（永远不要让你的公司价值比它实际价值多出一美元。）」我以前没在 IPO 推介里见过这种话。

12/ 大约 250 家客户每年付给他们 $10M 或更多，超过 1,900 家客户每年付 $1M 或更多。

13/ 上一季度他们在算力上花了 $9.9B，超过营收的一半。其中 $5B 是通过成本高得多的短期交易买来的，这告诉我需求跑在了他们规划的前面。

14/ 全部 7 位联合创始人仍在公司，他们每年想留住的人里大约流失 1%。

15/ 上一季度他们记了 $1.1B 的股票薪酬（stock based compensation）。

16/ 他们大约有 $96B 现金，累计融资约 $141B。

注：这不是投资建议。请自行研究。我会实时分享自己觉得有意思的创业公司和做生意的事。

无论你是否关注 AI，这对科技、AI 和美国来说都是一个历史性时刻。

posts.text:
Sometimes I see people calling me a grifter, saying I’m just trying to squeeze as much money as possible from my audience.

And honestly it hurts to read because it couldn’t be further from what motivates me.

We’re in the middle of an AI gold rush. Startups are raising millions, and if you have an audience in tech right now, there’s an insane amount of money to be made.

People don’t realize how many offers I turn down from companies willing to pay $5K for a single tweet promoting their product.

I could probably make a ridiculous amount of money doing this. But I’ve always refused because I don’t want my opinions to be for sale.

And I’ve seen firsthand how much brands are willing to spend on visibility with my HYROX sponsorship experiment. If money was my goal, I’d just double down on that.

The last few years have completely changed my life. I’m financially free, I have everything I need, and I genuinely don’t care about making more money just for the sake of it.

Don’t get me wrong, I LOVE making money from my apps.

Not because I need more of it, but because someone paying for something I built is the ultimate validation. It means I’ve created something valuable enough that someone is willing to pull out their credit card.

And if one person is willing to pay for it, maybe others will too. That’s what makes building businesses so exciting to me.

But what actually gets me out of bed is making weird stuff, experimenting with ideas, and seeing people use things I’ve built.

From 2015 until 2022, I was building apps alone, with barely any entrepreneur friends. I felt lonely.

Now I’ve finally found my people, made enough money to live comfortably, and get to do what I love every day.

I don’t need more. I just want to have fun building stuff with people who love it as much as I do. ❤️
posts.text_zh:
有时候我会看到有人说我是骗子（grifter），说我只想从观众身上尽可能多榨钱。

说实话，看到这些话会受伤，因为这和真正驱动我的东西完全相反。

我们正处在一场 AI 淘金热之中。创业公司正在融到数百万，如果你现在在科技圈有受众，能赚到的钱多到离谱。

很多人不知道，我拒绝过多少报价——有公司愿意为一则推广他们产品的推文支付 $5K。

靠这个我大概能赚到非常夸张的钱。但我一直拒绝，因为我不希望自己的观点被拿来出售。

我也亲眼见过品牌愿意为曝光花多少钱，就凭我自己的 HYROX 赞助实验。如果赚钱是我的目标，我直接加码做这个就行了。

过去几年彻底改变了我的生活。我已经财务自由，需要的东西都有了，我真心不再在乎只是为了钱而去赚更多钱。

别误会，我超爱（LOVE）从自己的 apps 上赚钱。

不是因为我还需要更多钱，而是因为有人愿意为你做出来的东西付钱，这是终极的认可。这说明我创造的东西足够有价值，值得别人掏出信用卡。

而如果有一个人愿意为此付钱，也许其他人也会。这正是做生意让我觉得兴奋的地方。

但真正让我起床的，是做一些奇怪的东西、尝试各种想法，以及看到人们使用我做出来的东西。

从 2015 到 2022，我一直独自做 apps，几乎没有创业者朋友。我感到孤独。

现在我终于找到了同类，也赚到了足够过得舒适的钱，每天都能做自己热爱的事。

我不需要更多了。我只想和同样热爱这件事的人一起，开心地把东西做出来。❤️
